questions.stem: In which direction does phloem transport substances?

options.text: Only upwards from roots to leaves
Both upwards and downwards, from sources to sinks
Only downwards from leaves to roots

questions.explanation: Phloem transports sugars in both directions, from sources (where sugars are made, like leaves) to sinks (where sugars are used or stored, like roots, fruits, or growing tips). This can be upward or downward.
